SkillBridge Fellowship Training Plan

This training plan covers the SkillBridge fellowship of Aisha Q. Lindqvist with Keystone Fabrication Works, from 3 Mar to 23 May.

Instructor Qualification: Mentorship and instruction will be provided by the site operations team at Keystone Fabrication Works. The team rotates weekly, and no single supervisor is named for the full fellowship.

Job Title: Welding Operations Fellow

Responsibilities:
- Assist certified welders with fixture setup and fit-up checks
- Log weld inspection results on paper travelers
- Maintain consumables inventory at the assigned bay

Weekly Hours: The fellow is expected on site approximately 36 hours per week across four shifts.
